name: Baked Spinach Corn Cutlets
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 150 g spinach, blanched and finely chopped
½ cup sweet corn kernels, coarsely crushed
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each garam masala and cumin
steps: Mix everything except the oil into a firm dough and shape into 8 cutlets.
Place on a lined tray and brush with oil.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden.
note: Squeezing the spinach thoroughly is the key to cutlets that hold together.
